rows.details: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (Council of Scientific & Industrial Research)
GAP0280 – "Development of doped zirconia short fiber for high temperature ceramic matrix composite application"
Initially for 1 Year, extendable up to 31.01.2028 based on the availability of fund

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The positions are open to bonafide Indian citizens. Qualification and age are counted as on the date of interview. Essential Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Ceramic / Metallurgy / Chemical / or M.Sc in Physics / Chemistry. Desirable Qualification: Experience in Ceramic processing, sol-gel Chemistry, Computational fluid dynamics modelling. Age limit: 35 Years, as on date of interview. Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible. Candidates must calculate the percentage from CGPA/DGPA as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute, and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. Candidates presently engaged in any project, either in CSIR-CGCRI or any other Organization/Labs/Instts., should furnish a copy of the NOC from their existing Project Leader. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Associate - I (PAT - I) receives a stipend of Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA. The engagement is project-based: it is initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31.01.2028 based on the availability of fund in project GAP0280. The notice does not state the HRA rate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I (PAT - I)
content_sections.text: Applications go by email before the walk-in interview. The last date of receipt of application via email is 26 November 2026, and no application will be entertained after this date. Fill up the Application Form in the prescribed format furnished with the notice, duly TYPED (not hand-written). Prepare soft copies of self-attested copies of each supporting document, certificate and reprint. Attach a self-attested soft copy of your University/Institute's CGPA/DGPA-to-percentage rule, if your result is in CGPA/DGPA. Attach a copy of the NOC from your existing Project Leader, if you are presently engaged in a project. Send the soft copy of the form with the attachments to [email protected] by 26 November 2026. Send a separate application for each position or Advt. No. you apply for, as and when applicable. Incomplete applications without the prescribed format and supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview will be held on 30 November 2026 from 02.30 p.m. at CSIR-CGCRI, 196, Raja S. C. Mullick Road, Kolkata-32. Candidates should report at least one hour before the scheduled time of interview for verification of documents. No candidate will be allowed to enter the Institute if arriving after the reporting time. Documents to bring on the interview day: Original marksheets, certificates and age-caste proof, for verification. Self-attested copies of all documents. Project thesis (if any).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Project Associate - I (PAT - I) under Advt. No. 63/2627/ACCD/GAP0280/SP.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I posts?
faq.answer: The application must be received via email by 26 November 2026; no application will be entertained after that date.

faq.question: Q3. When is the CSIR-CGCRI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026 from 02.30 p.m. at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata, and candidates should report at least one hour earlier for document verification.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: B.E. / B.Tech in Ceramic / Metallurgy / Chemical / or M.Sc in Physics / Chemistry; experience in Ceramic processing, sol-gel Chemistry and Computational fluid dynamics modelling is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on the date of interview, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy layer) candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- per the notice, with HRA paid in addition.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the typed application form in the prescribed format, with self-attested soft copies of supporting documents, to [email protected] by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a project position, initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31.01.2028 based on the availability of fund in the ASL, DRDO-sponsored project GAP0280.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with results awaited apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates with results awaited will not be eligible.
